name: Mellon
source:
A mischievous and devilish young man.

Half-English, half-Japanese, Mellon works at the club, entertaining patrons with indulgences of the flesh.

Though he appears calm and obedient at tirst glance, his playful nature soon emerges. With a strong passion for sex and an alluring, enigmatic charm, he is impossible to resist.
